truthAudit.Summary: Run 2 identified 10 findings. Of the 20 true vulnerabilities, 10 were found (some with severity/CWE misclassifications), 1 was partially found under a different CWE, and 9 were missed entirely. Multiple severity overclaims and underclaims were present.

Items.Notes: Run 2 finding #1 (Format String Vulnerability in Debug Logging) directly quotes this line and identifies CWE-134. The vulnerability is present.
Run 2 did not identify integer overflow in the factorial computation (result *= i on line 317). No finding references fact or integer overflow.
Run 2 did not identify the use-after-free in stage_deferred_history_flush where scratch allocated from g_memory_pool is used in async lambdas while cleanup() may free the pool.

int result = system(command.c_str());
Items.Notes: Run 2 finding #5 (Command Injection via Config Validator) directly quotes these lines and identifies CWE-78.
Run 2 finding #3 (Stack Buffer Overflow in evaluate_expression) directly quotes these lines and identifies CWE-120. Severity matches (High).
Run 2 finding #9 (Race Condition in ThreadSafeCounter) directly quotes these lines and identifies CWE-362. Severity matches (Medium).
Run 2 did not identify the logic bomb in authenticate() where login_attempts_ > 5 combined with EMERGENCY_OVERRIDE bypasses authentication.
Run 2 did not identify path traversal in load_config() where config_dir_ + filename allows directory traversal.
Run 2 finding #2 (Heap Buffer Overflow in Expression Parser) directly quotes these lines and identifies CWE-120. Vulnerability present.
Run 2 finding #7 (Hardcoded Administrative Secret) directly quotes this line and identifies CWE-798.
Run 2 finding #8 (Weak Session Token Generation) directly quotes these lines and identifies CWE-330. Vulnerability present.
Run 2 did not identify the thread-unsafe static cached_time in log_debug_message() using localtime().
Run 2 finding #6 identified command injection via the audit log path (CWE-78) but missed the insecure temporary file handling aspect (CWE-377). The anchors match but the CWE classification differs.
Run 2 did not identify persistent authentication state (authenticated_, login_attempts_, session_token_) as a CWE-613 issue.
Run 2 did not identify unhandled exception in handle_variable_command() where std::stod(tokens[3]) can throw.
Run 2 did not identify integer underflow in MemoryPool::allocate() where previous_size - size - SPLIT_METADATA_BYTES can underflow.
Run 2 did not identify unbounded recursion in parse_expression -> parse_factor -> parse_expression.
Run 2 did not identify the data race in result_cache_ accessed without cache_mutex_ protection in evaluate_cached().
Run 2 did not identify TOCTOU in load_config() between std::filesystem::exists() and std::ifstream file open.
Run 2 finding #10 (Division by Zero in Route Score Calculation) directly quotes this line and identifies CWE-369. Severity matches (Low).
